describe:
Uptime, in the ink colours, always in dark mode.
Keeps:
- outage: service: text; mins: number, 1 to 10000; cause: text, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "SLA target (%)": number, 90 to 100, starts at 99.9.
Works out:
- allowed is 43200 times the result of 100 minus sla rounded divided by 100.
- used is the total mins of outage this month.
Shows:
- a bar with "Uptime" and a button that opens a form to add a outage.
- used out of allowed with a progress bar, labelled "minutes down this month".
- a card with a big number the result of 100 minus used times 100 divided by 43200 times 1000 rounded divided by 1000, labelled "% available this month", with a ring toward 0 when there is one.
- a card titled "Worst services" with "minutes, this month" on the right, holding the lines under it.
- a list of outage by day; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
needs: log an outage with service, minutes and cause
allowed downtime this month from the SLA

describe:
Uniforms, in the blue colours.
Keeps:
- kid: name: text; size: one of Small, Medium, Large, starts at Medium; sets: number, 1 to 4, starts at 2. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Cloth per metre": money, starts at 650; "Stitching per set": money, starts at 1200.
Works out:
- metres is the sum of its sets times 1.8 when its size is Small, otherwise 2.2 when its size is Medium, otherwise 2.7 over the kid.
Shows:
- a bar with "Uniforms" and a button that opens a form to add a kid.
- a card with a big number metres times 10 rounded divided by 10, labelled "metres of cloth for" sumkid.sets "sets", with a ring toward 0 when there is one.
- a big number: metres times per m rounded, labelled "cloth".
- a big number: the total sets of kid times stitch, labelled "stitching".
- text: "Total", metres times per m plus the total sets of kid times stitch rounded.
- for each kid sorted by name:
  - a group; a tap opens the kid for editing; a swipe removes the kid, with undo:
    - text: the name of the kid.
    - text: the size of the kid, the plural of the sets of the kid.

Screen Time, in the purple colours, always in dark mode.
Keeps:
- use: app: one of Social, Video, Games, Messages, Other, starts at Social; mins: number, 1 to 600, starts at 30. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Daily budget (minutes)": number, 30 to 600, starts at 180.
Works out:
- today min is the total mins of use today.
Shows:
- a bar with "Screen Time" and a button that opens a form to add a use.
- a card with a big number today min, labelled "minutes used today of" budget, with a ring toward budget when there is one.
- if today min is more than budget:
  - text: "Over budget by", today min minus budget, "minutes.".
- otherwise:
  - text: "Left today:", the result of budget minus today min divided by 60 rounded down, "h", the result of budget minus today min leaves over when divided by 60, "min".
- a card titled "Last 7 days" with "" on the right, holding the lines under it.
- a list of use today; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
needs: add a session with app and minutes
last 7 days chart with budget line

describe:

describe:
Savings by Date, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- deposit: amount: money. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: target: money, starts at 120000; "Months to save": number, 1 to 60, starts at 12; "Started on": date, starts at today.
Works out:
- total is the total amount of deposit.
- end day is started plus months times 30.
- weeks left is the larger of the result of end day minus today divided by 7 rounded down and 1.
Shows:
- a bar with "Savings by Date" and a button that opens a form to add a deposit.
- a card with a big number total, labelled "saved of" target, with a ring toward target when there is one.
- text: "Save about", the larger of target minus total and 0 divided by weeks left rounded, "a week to arrive on time".
- a card titled "Pace" with "days left:" maxend_day - today, 0 on the right, holding the lines under it.
- a list of deposit, first 6; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
needs: target amount and months to save
shows how much to save per week to arrive on time

describe:

- qty is the total shares of buy.

- a bar with "Share Average" and a button that opens a form to add a buy.
- a card with a big number avg times 100 rounded divided by 100, labelled "average price for" pluralqty, "share", with a ring toward 0 when there is one.
- text: "Total invested", invested rounded.
- a box to fill in px, labelled "Price today".
- if px is more than 0 and qty is more than 0:
  - a card titled "If you sold now" with "" on the right, holding the lines under it.
- a card titled "Purchases" with "" on the right, holding the lines under it.
needs: add a purchase with shares and price
profit or loss in money and percent

describe:
Plaster mix, in the blue colours.
You can change: "Cement per bag": money, starts at 1300; "Sand per cu ft": money, starts at 90.
Works out:
- parts is 3 when mix is Mix13, otherwise 4 when mix is Mix14, otherwise 6.
- wet is area times 0.0929 times mm divided by 1000.
- dry is wet times 1.3.
- cem is dry divided by the result of 1 plus parts times 35.31.
- bags is cem divided by 1.25.
- sand ft is dry times parts divided by the result of 1 plus parts times 35.31.
Remembers while you use it: area, starting at 1000; mm, starting at 12; mix, starting at Mix14.
Shows:
- a card titled "The wall" with "" on the right, holding the lines under it.
- a card with a big number bags rounded, labelled "bags of cement", with a ring toward 0 when there is one.
- a big number: sand ft rounded, labelled "cu ft of sand".
- a big number: bags times bag plus sand ft times sand rounded, labelled "material cost".

Kameti, in the purple colours.
Works out:
- pot is members times amount.
- paid in is amount times turn.
- gain is pot minus paid in.
Remembers while you use it: members, starting at 12; amount, starting at 5000; turn, starting at 6.
Shows:
- a card titled "The committee" with "" on the right, holding the lines under it.
- a card with a big number pot, labelled "payout in month" minturn, members, with a ring toward 0 when there is one.
- a big number: amount times the lowest of members over the turn rounded, labelled "I will have paid by then".
- a big number: pot minus amount times the lowest of members over the turn rounded, labelled "difference".
- if turn is at most 1:
  - text: "Early turn: it works like an interest free loan.".
- otherwise:
  - if turn is at least members:

describe:
Estate and will, in the yellow colours.

- will ok is the smaller of will and net divided by 3.
- rest is net minus will ok.
- units is sons times 2 plus daughters.
- per is rest divided by the larger of units and 1.
Remembers while you use it: estate, starting at 0; debts, starting at 0; will, starting at 0; sons, starting at 2; daughters, starting at 2.
Shows:
- a screen "Setup":
  - a box to fill in estate, labelled "Estate".
  - a box to fill in debts, labelled "Debts and funeral".
  - a box to fill in will, labelled "Amount in the will".
  - text: "Sons", sons.
  - a slider for sons from 0 to 8.
  - text: "Daughters", daughters.
  - a slider for daughters from 0 to 8.
- a screen "Shares":
  - if net is 0:
    - text: "Enter the estate on the Setup tab.".
  - otherwise:
    - a card with a big number rest rounded, labelled "left for the children after debts and will", with a ring toward 0 when there is one.
    - if will is more than net divided by 3:
      - text: "The will is above one third, so only", will ok rounded, "is counted.".
    - text: "Each son", per times 2 rounded.
    - text: "Each daughter", per rounded.
    - text: "Rule: the will is limited to 1/3 of what is left after debts; a son gets twice a daughter. A guide only.".
needs: remaining split between sons and daughters
